definitions.explanation: Weak, self-pitying complaints or expressions of helplessness. Carries a negative nuance of complaining without trying to solve the problem.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{言|ごと}ばかり{言|い}っていても{何|なに}も{変|か}わらない。
examples.english: Nothing will change if you just keep complaining.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{最後|さいご}まで{泣|な}き{言|ごと}を{言|い}わずに{仕事|しごと}をやり{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: He completed the job without complaining until the very end.

notes:
USAGE: {泣|な}き{言|ごと} implies weak, self-pitying complaints rather than legitimate grievances. It is most commonly used in the pattern {泣|な}き{言|ごと}を{言|い}う (to whine, to complain).

The word carries a negative connotation — using it implies that the speaker considers the complaints unjustified or unproductive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}を{言|い}う: to whine, to complain
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}を{言|い}わない: to not complain
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}ばかり: nothing but whining

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}: self-pitying complaint (negative nuance)
- {愚痴|ぐち}: grumbling, griping (general complaint)
- {文句|もんく}: complaint, objection (can be legitimate or not)
